subject: School Committee Charter Provisions
overview: The subcommittee reviewed and revised draft charter language for Article 4 governing the School Committee, addressing prohibitions, compensation, vacancy succession, and committee powers. The subcommittee agreed to present its draft recommendations, including a structure of four district seats and two at-large members, to the full committee.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The subcommittee voted to table approval of the minutes from March 19, 2024.

items.title: Section 4-3: Prohibitions
items.summary: Members reviewed restrictions on holding other paid municipal positions, agreeing to keep the language consistent with City Council provisions while adding an explicit exception for the mayor serving on the committee.

items.title: Section 4-4: Compensation
items.summary: The subcommittee agreed to align compensation setting with City Council procedures and decided to omit clauses regarding expense reimbursement and health insurance from the draft charter text.

items.title: Section 4-6: Filling of Vacancies
items.summary: The subcommittee examined vacancy replacement options across district and at-large seats, agreeing to draft language reflecting a recommendation of four double-ward districts and two at-large members.

items.title: Section 4-5: Powers and Duties
items.summary: The subcommittee revised draft language to state that individual members cannot act without authorization by a majority vote of the committee, added superintendent evaluation to duties, and modified language regarding school maintenance policies.

items.title: Community Participation Policy
items.summary: The subcommittee decided to defer deliberations on public participation rules for school committee meetings to the full Charter Study Committee.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: No members of the public were present to comment.
